column1: # Rows db.ps15b.* (line PS, PS15b-1, DECISIONS 79): psiblast's outfmt 5, 8, 9 and 11 per round (and 10 and 20 with -in_pssm and -in_msa) for a FASTA query, -in_pssm and -in_msa, with -db (tests/db_search/paja) and -subject; the ncbi rows are NCBI 2.17.0 `psiblast ... -num_threads 1`. The archive (outfmt 11) is written per round with the round's request (the query, or the PSSM of a PSSM round) and its untrimmed results; a -subject PSSM round stops with NCBI's engine error. Freeze them alone with `freeze --only db.ps15b.`.

# Rows db.ps15b.fix.* (review fixes of PS15b-1, 2026-11-23): B1, psiblast's results carry no query masks in any round (BLAST XML with -seg yes, -lcase_masking and -in_pssm; outfmt 0 of a record that is both a query and a subject under -parse_deflines); B2, a PSSM query of an integer local id keeps its Object-id in the Seq-aligns (outfmt 8 and 11).

# Rows db.ps15b.xmlarch.* (review fixes of PS15b-1, XA, 2026-11-23, refusals until line RG-F3's PR 2; ncbi rows since, agent D7 of ad-RG-F3-5, 2026-11-24): -outfmt 11 in XML or ASN.1 binary (ARCHIVE_FORMAT=xml, bin) of a PSSM file whose members PS15b-1's streams did not write (an anonymous SEQUENCE or CHOICE, a NULL, a UTF8String, a NaN or infinite REAL, a delayed member), the XML ones on the one-column PSSM ps7_one (NCBI's XML archive of the 30-column PSSMs is 193-195 KB); .dlcopy.*: a delayed member of the archive's own format, copied; .upd.* and db.ps15b.dlpost.last: the same object written in ASN.1 text first (-out_pssm as round 1 starts, the search strategy's request before the rounds), which reads each delay buffer of another format into the object once (CDelayBuffer::Update, one post), so the archive and a second -out_pssm write the values read (PssmWithParameters::update_delayed). Rows .dlpost.*: a delayed member of another format that NCBI reads while it writes the archive with a post (803.7), which the archive's messages do not hold. Rows db.ps15b.dlread.* (refusals db.ps15b.rej.dlread.* until line RG-F3 item O-2, 2026-11-28): one whose read fails (an INTEGER past Int4 in the XML PSSM ps9_xml_dl_ovf.xml, .ovf*, or its BER twin ps9_ber_dl_ovf.asnb, .bovf*): NCBI's exception after the archive up to the member, then the error archive, rc 255.

# Rows db.ps15b.rej.ratio.* and db.ps15b.xmlarch.bin.real (a refusal until line RG-F3's PR 2), db.ps15b.fix.self.lcm.* (second review fixes of PS15b-1, B1, S1, S2, 2026-11-23): -outfmt 11 with a database of a PSSM of frequency ratios only without params.rpsdbparams, refused before any output in the ASN.1 text, XML and binary archives (NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 stops with a C++ exception, rc 255, while it writes the request's PSSM); the binary archive of a PSSM with an infinite real number; psiblast's outfmt 0 of a record that is both a query and a subject under -parse_deflines -lcase_masking (no query masks, so no refusal).
